+

+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:3` — Public enum `Chat` lacks documentation. This is a top-level public type that users interact with directly and needs explanation of its purpose. Add a doc comment explaining the purpose of the Chat enum (e.g., `/// Namespace for chat message types.`).
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:4` — Public struct `Message` lacks documentation. This is a core public API type representing chat messages and needs usage documentation. Add a doc comment explaining the Message struct's role and typical usage (e.g., representing a single message in a conversation).
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:23` — Public struct `Tool` lacks documentation. This nested public struct represents tool metadata and needs explanation of its purpose and usage. Add a doc comment explaining that Tool holds tool-call or tool-result metadata for messages.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:46` — Public initializer lacks documentation. The main Message init has many parameters and needs explanation of their purpose and default behavior. Add a doc comment with parameter descriptions (e.g., role, content, images array, videos array, audios array, and optional tool metadata).
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:67` — Chat.Message.tool() now accepts an images parameter (line 44), and TranscriptConverter.mlxMessages() properly extracts images from toolOutput segments and passes them when creating tool messages. However, MessageGenerator.generate(message:) at line 67 only includes role, content, and tool metadata—not images, videos, or audios. On the tool-calling render path (MLXLanguageModel.runToolCalling, ~line 1757), MessageGenerator converts Chat.Messages to dictionaries before passing to applyChatTemplate, silently stripping any images present in tool-output entries. Update MessageGenerator.generate(message:) to include media fields: add `if !message.images.isEmpty { dictionary["images"] = message.images }` and similar for videos and audios, so images from tool outputs survive the tool-calling render path.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:67` — Public static factory `assistant(_:images:videos:toolCalls:)` lacks documentation. This factory creates assistant messages and needs explanation. Add a doc comment explaining that this creates an assistant message, optionally with media attachments and tool calls.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:78` — Public static factory `user(_:images:videos:audios:)` lacks documentation. This factory creates user messages and needs explanation. Add a doc comment explaining that this creates a user/prompt message with optional image, video, and audio attachments.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:99` — Public enum `Role` lacks documentation. This enum defines message sender roles and needs explanation of its purpose and values. Add a doc comment explaining that Role enumerates the possible message sender roles (user, assistant, system, tool).
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:155` — Public extension method `generate(message:)` lacks documentation. This is a public extension method on MessageGenerator that provides default implementation and needs documentation. Add a doc comment explaining this generates a message dictionary from a Chat.Message by extracting role and content and applying tool metadata.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:173` — Public extension method `generate(messages:)` lacks documentation. This is a public method providing a default implementation for the protocol requirement. Add a doc comment explaining this generates message dictionaries from an array of Chat.Message objects.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:183` — Public extension method `generate(from:)` lacks documentation. This is a public method providing a default implementation for converting UserInput to messages. Add a doc comment explaining this generates messages from UserInput by dispatching on the prompt type.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:203` — Public initializer in `DefaultMessageGenerator` lacks documentation. While the struct has a doc comment, the initializer itself is undocumented. Add a doc comment for the init method, or rely on the struct-level documentation as sufficient since this is a simple default initializer.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:211` — Public initializer in `NoSystemMessageGenerator` lacks documentation. While the struct has a doc comment, the initializer itself is undocumented. Add a doc comment for the init method.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift:215` — Public override method `generate(messages:)` in `NoSystemMessageGenerator` lacks documentation. This overrides the default extension implementation with custom filtering logic. Add a doc comment explaining this generates messages while filtering out system role messages.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/UnsupportedTranscriptContentMappingTests.swift:84` — Test function name breaks established project convention: all test functions in TranscriptConverterTests.swift use `test` prefix (e.g., `testConvertInstructionsToSystemMessage`), but this test function omits it. Rename to `testImageProcessingFailureMapsToTypedError` to match the established convention.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/UnsupportedTranscriptContentMappingTests.swift:111` — Test function name breaks established project convention: all test functions in TranscriptConverterTests.swift use `test` prefix, but this test function omits it. Rename to `testToolOutputImageProcessingFailureMapsToTypedError` to match the established convention.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/UnsupportedTranscriptContentMappingTests.swift:186` — Test function name breaks established project convention: all test functions in TranscriptConverterTests.swift use `test` prefix, but this test function omits it. Rename to `testEarlierTurnImageStillMapsLaterTextOnlyFailure` to match the established convention.
